pr_comments: Please ignore the first commit (which is the dependent PR #11948)

Note that currently genpkey passes when the generated pkey is not successfully written to a file. Does this need to be fixed?

NOTE: until the serializer can by seperated out as another provider, this test will not write out the key.
The genpkey test is now failing in fips mode - as there is no way to find the serializer to write out the key currently.

Now that the base provider works, this uncovered another issue where the RSA object differs between the FIPS_MODULE and the base.. Which is not so good for i2d which uses offsets into this RSA object.
Before trying to merge - I noticed that openssl-genpkey.pod.in contained some libctx related fields that were replaced by an environment variable. So a small change was required to delete these.

issue_context.title: Openssl 3.0.0alpha3 fips provider - RSA keygen doesn't allow 2048 < modulus < 3072

review_comments: Side note: I provided the same patch to @romen recently in relation to #12291.

Matt's patch somehow broke the tests for EC in FIPS mode in #12291 that are currently working.

I wish we could merge 12291 before fixing things that break other things!

So that implies that the export is not working correctly for some edge case in ec and will need to be fixed.
You may notice that this PR is 60 PR's older than your one :) and it  is actually green.

I am not opposed to merge this of course, but I would answer that we have been merging a lot of functionality without adding tests to make sure everything added is covered though.

That one is not green because it only adds tests that should have been showstoppers for previous PRs that got already merged!
Are you going to tell me that after your tests work that we have covered everything? :)

Obviously 😂

OK, I am rereading my previous comment and it can indeed be read way more aggressively than I intended it to be!
Thanks for adding extra tests, I cant always think of every possible scenario..
